title: Maintenance
description: Default settings for per-page maintenance mode. Individual pages can override these in their Page Data JSON.

message.label: Default Message
message.help: Shown to visitors when a page is in maintenance mode. Pages can override this in their Page Data.

retryAfter.label: Default Retry-After (seconds)
retryAfter.help: Value for the Retry-After response header. Tells crawlers and clients how long to wait before retrying.
